content.short: DeSciWorld is the global information aggregation and social engagement hub of the DeSci space.
content.description: Institutional constraints—such as selective funding and misaligned incentives—have limited scientific innovation. The DeSci movement aims to address these issues by decentralizing gatekeepers, funding bodies, and publication journals, returning power over science to the people. Diversity and representation remain serious gaps in traditional academia. The DeSci community is still nascent and often disorganized. DeSciWorld serves as a starting point for newcomers, offering a resource-oriented hub for exploring and contributing to the DeSci space.
